reasons: Section 11.1–11.3 supplies all three preferred elements: up to six months of transition assistance (at expiring Order Form rates, better than then-current rates), return of all Customer Data within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and secure deletion with written officer certification thereafter.

The only carve-outs (a legally required retained copy, kept protected and use-restricted; deletion from backups as they cycle) are standard and do not defeat the fallback, let alone approach walk-away territory (no data return / immediate deletion).

Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or comment was proposed; the rendered text is unchanged and the deterministic check confirms a data return/transition clause is present. Rationale accurately reflects the cited paragraphs.
